reuse.why: Builds on the existing link guard that every provider calls, and pulls the 'unlink account' field reset out of unlinkAccount into clearBankAccountLink so both the unlink action and the takeover use it.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset now exists once instead of being copied; the flag is only threaded through the six provider entry points that already destructure their params.

placement.why: Link preconditions and the unlink helper sit in accounts/link.ts, but the renamed prepareBankAccountLink now mixes a validation guard with a mutation (unlinking the holder) in one function.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the flag, the guard, the extracted unlink helper and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear shared helpers and tests; a reader has to know that the 'prepare' step can already have written to the database before the rest of the link runs.
